question: Which Gateway IPv6 bind contract should OpenClaw expose for LAN/custom BYOH deployments?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally describe this path as IPv4-only, while native IPv6 or dual-stack listening changes non-loopback reachability and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Contract
options.body: Introduce a documented IPv6 or dual-stack bind path with security warnings, platform listener semantics, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Change LAN/Custom In Place
options.body: Make existing `lan` or `customBindHost` accept IPv6 directly, accepting the compatibility and exposure risk as the new behavior for those modes.

options.title: Keep Core IPv4-Only
options.body: Leave core bind behavior IPv4-only and continue documenting reverse-proxy or sidecar workarounds for IPv6-only platforms.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a documented IPv6 or dual-stack bind path with security warnings, platform listener semantics, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway bind and BYOH documentation history points to this area, though security review should also be involved before implementation.
